gameVersionCovered: In-game screenshots from 2026-03-02 (post v2.3.1 mod rework, pre-3.0); official runtime tables decoded June-July 2026; meta-builds export for game v3.0.5 (2026-09-25); calculator repos 2024-09 .. 2026-09-25

keyClaims.claim: In-game Tier V weapon card DMG = round(officialGunPresetAttack[artLevel 5] × presetAttackRatio[star]) with ratio = 1 + 0.05×(star−1) for epic/legendary blueprints (1★ 1.00 … 6★ 1.25); uncommon DE.50 ladder 1.0/1.0625/1.125; common AA12 1.0.
keyClaims.evidence: 33 card readings from three screenshots (stars verified at 3× zoom) all reproduce within ±0.5, e.g. Jaws 2★ 789 = 751×1.05, 6★ 939 = 751×1.25; Compound Bow 1★ 1812 → 6★ 2265; Little Jaws 3★ 184 = 167×1.10; ladder values from decoded script.npk tables weaponBlueprintCalibrations.presetAttackRatio and gunPresetStats.gunPresetAttack.

keyClaims.claim: OHDB's listed 'Tier 5' damage (e.g. DE.50 Jaws 494, SOCR 174, Bullseye 1216) is the official artLevel-4 preset; the in-game endgame Tier V card uses artLevel 5, which is ~1.52× higher (751, 264, 1848) before star scaling. Any calculator seeded from OHDB (OHCalc examples, lReDragol, saitoh183, joseph) understates card DMG by ~34%.
keyClaims.evidence: gunPresetStats ladder for Jaws artLevel 0..9 = 99,128,198,316,494,751,988…; OHDB mirror weapons.json damage 494; screenshot 1★/2★ cards 751-based.

keyClaims.claim: Blueprint base Crit Rate / Crit DMG / Weakspot DMG come from the official blueprint-calibration table attrs E0100/E0200/E0300 and match the cards exactly (Jaws 6/25/60, Bullseye 2/26/95, Corrosion 8/27/15, Octopus 5/40/50, PDW90 8/45/30, Brahminy 2/30/80); fire rate = 60/autoTimeInterval (DE.50 0.315 s → 190.5 RPM, card 190); DE.50 falloff points [20 m, 1.0] and [32 m, 0.25].
keyClaims.evidence: official-runtime-catalog.json weaponBlueprintCalibrations and gunRuntimeStats vs screenshot cards.

keyClaims.claim: Crit DMG and Weakspot DMG are additive inside one hit multiplier: hit = base × (1 + critDmg + weakspotDmg); this is the model used by KremaOps, OHCalc spec ('observed'), OHMM templates and the 0x91CEA55 HitAmplifier bucket, while getzity (2024) and lReDragol (2026) multiply them.
keyClaims.evidence: Verbatim code: KremaOps `critHit = adjustedBase * (1 + effectiveCritDmg + totalWeakspotMult)`; OHCalc 05-validation-plan pass condition `weakspotCrit / body = 1 + critDamage + weakspotDamage`; lReDragol `damage *= (1+crit/100)` then `*= (1+weakspot/100)`.

keyClaims.claim: Keyword 'DMG Factor' and 'DMG Coefficient' bonuses add inside one multiplicative bucket (Factor bucket), separate from a 'Final DMG' bucket: 267 Psi × 0.5 × (1 + 0.15 − 0.30) = 113.475 → observed 113 (the '113 Test').
keyClaims.evidence: INGAME_KNOWLEDGE_BIBLE.md and ADR-002 in 0x91CEA55/OnceHuman; restated in OHMM archive report.

keyClaims.claim: Recovered official damage formula terminal: final_attack = max(base_attack × final_attack_additional_rate × final_attack_ignore_dam_rate × final_special_regulate_factor, 0), with final_attack_additional_rate = 1 + gate × Σ(weapon/attack_type/gun_type/element_type/keyword_proc/species/debuff add rates); PvE defaults pvp_adjust_factor = special_regulate_factor = 1; crit/weakspot/anomaly rolls use PRD with speed factor 0.8.
keyClaims.evidence: officialFormulaMetadata.ts and officialFormulaGraphRecipes.ts (soul_id 331, 'high' confidence for terminal, 'medium' for the additive sub-tree).

keyClaims.claim: Community DPS conventions worth adopting: expected hit = Σ over {body/weakspot}×{crit/non-crit} weighted by pCrit and pWeakspot (OHCalc, 0x91CEA55); standard DPS = avgHit×mag/(mag/(RPM/60)+reload); burst DPS = avgHit×RPM/60; reload: final = base/(1+reloadEfficiency) is official (2025-05-21 patch note).

No public calculator ships validated in-game hit vectors: OHMM's 23 'observed cases' are synthetic placeholders, bramsey's engine is a placeholder score, joseph's optimizer is a weighted score, and meta-builds/OHDB/wikily/ohdex do not publish their formulas.
keyClaims.evidence: formulaObservedCases.ts tags 'synthetic','placeholder'; bramsey app.js computeScore(); joseph README 'not the game's exact formula'.

keyClaims.claim: Burn/Power Surge/Frost Vortex coefficients are NOT settled: Burn 0.12×Psi/stack (0x91CEA55, OHMM) vs 0.4×Psi per 1 s (lReDragol) vs in-game card text '10% Psi every 0.5 s for 6 s, up to 5 stacks' (KAM Crank); Power Surge pure DoT vs hybrid; Frost Vortex DoT vs single 0.6×Psi hit.
keyClaims.evidence: keywords.ts, formulaTemplates.ts, context_module.py, lReDragol weapon_list.json effect text.

keyClaims.claim: Lunar suffix gold caps: Crit DMG +30%, Elemental +16%, Weapon/Status +12% (purple = 80% of gold); Crescent gold: Crit DMG +10% base +15% extra at 40% shield, Elemental +5%+8%, Weapon/Status +4%+6%.
